name: Mama no Bonyuu
source:
Our protagonist, Tachibana Yuya, lives with his stepmother, Kaori, who runs a small modeling agency.
Although Yuya is deeply attracted to Minako, who moved in next door six months ago, he lives his days peacefully without confessing his feelings.

One day, Yuya witnesses Kaori in the indecent act of masturbating, squirting breast milk during a climax.
Shocked, Yuya goes to the park, feeling distressed, but Minako, who happens to be passing by, invites him over for tea at her house.
Seeing Yuya struggling with his feelings for his mother, Minako gently embraces him.
"I'll never abandon you. Never again..."
Minako whispers this as she begins to service Yuya with her mouth...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=730786]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公橘裕也与继母香里住在一起。香里经营着一家小型模特经纪公司。
裕也深深迷恋半年前搬到隔壁的美奈子，却始终没有表白，只是平静地过着每一天。

一天，裕也撞见香里自慰时的淫靡景象：她在高潮中喷出了母乳。
大受冲击的裕也心烦意乱地来到公园，恰好路过的美奈子却邀请他到家里喝茶。
看见裕也正为自己对母亲的感情挣扎，美奈子温柔地将他拥入怀中。
“我绝不会抛弃你。再也不会……”
美奈子如此低语着，随即开始用嘴服侍裕也……
